decisions.reason: Its own webpage signals visible public commitment and sunk investment, and early results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
As a product line with several models, it has higher sunk investment and public commitment, making dropping less likely under escalation of commitment.
Its dedicated webpage and building on established offer signal commitment, and any disappointing early results can be treated as temporary, favoring persistence.
Only a website mention indicates lower public commitment and possibly less sunk investment, raising the drop likelihood relative to the others, but early results can still be seen as temporary.
